Lesson A Stand out from the crowd!
A )c D 2.02 What do you think employers look for in job applicants? Make a list.
Then read the article. Which of your ideas are mentioned?
In today's job market, candidates face stiff competition. The
evidence suggests that applicants who do their homework on
an employer before they submit an application stand out from the crowd.
Recent research shows what employers look for in new hires. Information like
this is often the key to landing your dream job.
1. PEOPLE Who have long-Term potential In interview S, show interest
in moving ahead in your career. Ask about the career paths of other employees
2. EVIDENCE YOU CAN WORK WELL WITH OTHERS Give an example of
how you collaborated with others on a project to make progress, meet
3. AN ABILITY TO MAKE MONEY For the COMPANY Explain ho W your
work can make or save money for the company.
4. AN IMPRESSIVE RESUME Highlight the experience and skills that are
relevant for each employer, as well as details of your education. Show your
resume to a career counselor or someone with experience in management
and follow their advice. Their feedback is invaluable.
5. Relevant work EXPERIENCE Emphasize the skills and knowledge you
have acquired in other jobs, and include any relevant training you have had
